% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpPuzzle[src=/docs/components/puzzle/examples/landscape.svg,pieces=12,alt=Mountain lake at sunrise]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/puzzle/puzzle.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-puzzle");
element1.setAttribute("src", "/docs/components/puzzle/examples/landscape.svg");
element1.setAttribute("pieces", "12");
element1.setAttribute("alt", "Mountain lake at sunrise");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Square pieces
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpPuzzle[src=/docs/components/puzzle/examples/landscape.svg,pieces=9,shape=square,exact-orientation,alt=Mountain lake at sunrise]{}
\end{document}
